AdminAccount.title: AdminAccount
AdminAccount.description: Protected admin credentials and verification metadata stored per authorized admin UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the admin document ID.

email.description: Verified Google account email of the admin.

adminUsername.description: Custom admin username used for the secondary admin gate.

passwordSalt.description: Random hex salt used for SHA-256 admin password hashing.

passwordHash.description: Salted SHA-256 hash of the admin password (never plaintext).

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

RegisteredUser.title: RegisteredUser
RegisteredUser.description: Cloud-synced app user profile used for live admin user counting and version visibility.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the admin user directory.

ispUsername.description: Optional ISP subscriber username linked with the user.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AppConfig.title: AppConfig
AppConfig.description: Global application branding (display name, launcher icon preset) and future APK update control managed by admin.

appDisplayName.description: Dynamic app title shown across the app (max 30 chars).

appSubtitle.description: Dynamic subtitle shown beneath the app title.

launcherPreset.description: Active launcher icon and home-screen alias preset.

updateUrl.description: Direct download URL for the APK update.

forceUpdate.description: Whether users must update before continuing.

updateTitle.description: Dialog headline shown when a new update is available.

updateMessage.description: Dialog description shown when a new update is available.

releaseNotes.description: Summary of changes in the new update.

updatedByUid.description: Admin UID who last updated the configuration.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

BroadcastNotification.title: BroadcastNotification
BroadcastNotification.description: Admin-authored real-time broadcast notification delivered to all users.

category.description: Notification category for styling and filtering.

published.description: Whether the broadcast is actively published to users.

senderUid.description: Admin UID that published this broadcast.

createdAt.description: Server creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/admins/{adminId}.description: Admin account records holding secondary username and salted SHA-256 password hash.

/users/{userId}.description: Cloud-synced app user records for admin user count and version monitoring.

/app_config/{configId}.description: Singleton app_config/main document controlling remote branding and APK updates.

/broadcasts/{broadcastId}.description: Real-time announcements published by admin to all connected clients.
